invitation.subject: {inviterName} invited you to {tenantName}
invitation.heading: {inviterName} invited you to join {tenantName} as {roleName}.
invitation.fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
invitation.footer: You received this because someone invited this address. If you weren’t expecting it, you can ignore it.

deletionWarning.subject: {tenantName} will be deleted on {purgesOn}
deletionWarning.preheader: It is closed. Contact us to reopen it before that date.
deletionWarning.heading: {tenantName} is closed.
deletionWarning.body: It will be deleted with all its data on {purgesAt}.
deletionWarning.contact: <link>Contact us</link> to reopen it before that date.
deletionWarning.footer: You received this because you are an Owner of {tenantName}.

notificationEmail.fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:

member.role_changed.title: Your role in {tenantName} changed

actorName.body: The platform changed your role from {oldRoleName} to {newRoleName}.

member.role_changed.footer: You got this email because your access to an organisation changed.

member.removed.title: You were removed from {tenantName}
member.removed.body: {actorName} removed you from {tenantName}. You can no longer open it or see its notifications.
member.removed.footer: You got this email because your access to an organisation changed.

member.joined.title: {memberName} joined {tenantName}
member.joined.body: {memberName} accepted your invitation and joined as {roleName}.

tenant.plan_changed.title: {tenantName} is now on {newPlanName}
tenant.plan_changed.body: The platform moved your organisation from {oldPlanName} to {newPlanName}. Its features and limits follow the new plan.
tenant.plan_changed.footer: You got this email because you are an Owner of this organisation.

tenant.entitlement_override_set.title: A plan value changed for {tenantName}
tenant.entitlement_override_set.body: The platform set {keyName} to {value} for your organisation. Your plan’s value applies again on {expiresAt}.

expiresAt.body: The platform set {keyName} to {value} for your organisation, with no end date.

tenant.entitlement_override_removed.title: A plan value changed for {tenantName}
tenant.entitlement_override_removed.body: The platform removed the exception for {keyName}. Your plan’s value applies again: {value}.

tenant.owner_joined.title: {tenantName} has its Owner
tenant.owner_joined.body: {ownerName} accepted the Owner invitation. {tenantName} is ready to use.

tenant.suspended.title: {tenantName} was suspended
tenant.suspended.body: {actorName} suspended {tenantName}. Its members can’t open it until it is reactivated.
tenant.suspended.footer: You got this email because you are a system admin and an organisation’s status changed.

tenant.reactivated.title: {tenantName} was reactivated
tenant.reactivated.body: {actorName} reactivated {tenantName}. Its members can open it again.
tenant.reactivated.footer: You got this email because you are a system admin and an organisation’s status changed.

tenant.closed.title: {tenantName} was closed
tenant.closed.body: {actorName} closed {tenantName}. It will be deleted on {reopenableUntil} unless someone reopens it.
tenant.closed.footer: You got this email because you are a system admin and an organisation’s status changed.

tenant.reopened.title: {tenantName} was reopened
tenant.reopened.footer: You got this email because you are a system admin and an organisation’s status changed.

tenant.purged.title: {tenantName} was deleted
tenant.purged.body: The platform finished deleting {tenantName} and its data. Its name and slug stay in the list.
tenant.purged.footer: You got this email because you are a system admin and an organisation’s status changed.
